title: Manufacturing, Distributing or Possessing with Intent to Distribute CDS
grade_or_penalty: Heroin, cocaine and similar: 1st degree (5 oz or more), 2nd degree (0.5 to under 5 oz), 3rd degree (under 0.5 oz). Fentanyl and other Schedule I-II drugs graded by amount. Other schedules and marijuana graded by drug and quantity
key_points: Knowingly or purposely manufacturing, distributing or dispensing CDS, or possessing it with intent to do so.
Intent to distribute is shown by quantity, packaging, scales, cash and similar evidence.
